column1: # The 34 published clonal-complex assays of Felix et al. 2023 (Microbiol Spectr 11:e03954-22,
# doi:10.1128/spectrum.03954-22), their Table 1. The primers and TaqMan probes were designed on
# kmers and point mutations found in 954 Listeria monocytogenes genomes (at least 15 per clonal
# complex) and checked in silico against a further 2,388 - the same idea as primer-finder.
# Sequences are given without their dye (FAM, HEX or Cy5 on the 5' end) and quencher (BBQ).
# `target` is the group of the paper; the SD_ and ST-suffixed ones resolve subdivisions within a
# clonal complex and so need an ST-level inclusion group, not a CC-level one.
